findings.label: Default config seeds no mode definitions
findings.detail: home-manager module defaults modes.projects=[] and globalStorage=false, so the custom-mode definitions (roomodes.yaml) reach no discovery path out of the box; only ~/.roo rules/skills/commands are seeded. Matches the documented strategy but is a usability trap. Consider documenting prominently or defaulting globalStorage on for the chosen editor.

findings.label: Toolchain patch drift unpinned
findings.detail: nixpkgs ships node 22.23.3 (repo pins 22.23.1) and pnpm 10.34.5 (repo pins 10.8.1); not overridden. Justified and documented (non-fatal engine warning; lockfileVersion 9.0 reads under any pnpm 10.x). Residual risk is a future nixpkgs bump silently changing the toolchain. Acceptable.

findings.label: menagerie-cli deferred by design
findings.detail: apps/cli is intentionally not an output; documented as a known follow-up requiring ripgrep wiring, not a gap.
